review.name: Granite Gargoyle
findings: Fresh baseline six head and six full-body raw slices across all thirteen clips and all 216 native equipped technique frames actually inspected. Lower red mask and chin distort during secondary idle, recoil, victory and tilted defeat. Wings and all body joints remain connected. Separate complete-mask binding candidate pending.

Separate second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices across low and medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native equipped technique frames in twelve lossless strips and all sixteen atlas cells. All passed. Full geometry 203 poses per asset with zero warnings; original independent face landmarks and 468 blends pass. Complete lower mask binding preserves sculpt, topology, textures, rig, all authored animation curves and 21059 protected vertex palettes. Seven focused regression/animation-bank tests and production build passed. Whole roster and live release pending.
